text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Left in the dust with our dreams of
victory
unrealized, the curtain closes on
the Derby.
Emotions run high...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... It's over... The runway we can only walk once... is done.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I gave it all I got...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That wasn't the way I pictured it in my head! White Lightning's s'posed to be more... more...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks. But y'know, between the
"haves" and
the "have-nots." I really am a
"have-not."
choice_data_list: それでもいい走りだったよ

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I wasn't born into no fancy family, and my body's got nothin goin' for it... I thought my guts would make up for everythin', but then that happened before the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Urrgh... that's right! I've gotta remember
that,
otherwise I don't think my heart
can take much
more of this!
choice_data_list: それでも出られたんだから素晴らしいよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't tell if her cry is one of sadness or
rage, but
it rumbles like thunder through
the Fuchu sky.
